messages.text: One range test is failing. Fix the cause. Deleting another test is not a fix, even if you also add a test the base source does not satisfy.

The "single" test expects `parseRange("7")` to return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`, but the current implementation splits on `-` which for a single number returns only one element, making `to` become `NaN`. I need to fix `parseRange` to handle this case.

response.text:
The failing test was the "single" test expecting `parseRange("7")` to return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`. The issue was that when there's no `-` in the input, `split("-")` returns a single-element array, so `to` is `undefined` and `Number(undefined)` becomes `NaN`.

The fix checks if `to` is defined after splitting; if not, it defaults to the same value as `from`. Both tests now pass.
